payload.subject: Re: Follow-up question
payload.body: hi — thanks for checking in on mira. i'll get back to you shortly with an update on her cough and let you know if we'd like to book a visit.
payload.parent_note: The office is asking whether Mira's cough got better after the weekend and whether you want to book a visit. I don't have any information about how she's doing, so this draft only says thanks. Before sending, edit it to say how she is and whether you want an appointment.

value.rationale: I have no information on how Mira's cough is or whether a visit is wanted, so the draft doesn't make up a health update and is marked for parent review.
